notes.title: Retiring Sale
notes.notes:
Since I've got some requests for a sale before The Architect gets retired, the sale is ON with the Steam Lunar New Year Sale!

Have fun!

notes.title: Retiring
notes.notes:
Since the game was released nearly 4 years ago, and I don't have the resources to support it, I'm retiring it from Steam.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Trading Cards Released!
notes.notes:
After a week in review with  fixes and re-reviews, Trading Cards were approved and we released them!

Have fun!

notes.title: v1.0.4: Achievements!
notes.notes:
As requested by you, we added 19 achievements to the game. Enjoy!

As a side-note, we fixed some bugs too: time counting and level save/load loading incorrect level.

notes.title: Achievements incoming shortly
notes.notes:
These weeks we've been working on adding achievements to the game. You can already view them, but at the moment we're testing the game with them, so it we didn't update it yet.

Update incoming next week!

notes.title: V1.0.3: Workshop fix & optimization
notes.notes:
Fixed:
[list]
[*]Level screenshot for Workshop was not created every time. Now it's fixed size, no more screen flickering when level was uploading to Workshop.
[*]small performance optimization
[/list]

PS: Did you check the new level in the Workshop: Eye Blender?

notes.title: V1.0.2: Small Additions & Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Added:
[list]
[*] player level-end animation
[*] larger sidescroll area, so you can now scroll the level easier
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*] secondary levels were loaded as custom levels in some cases
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.1: Workshop Support and Cloud Saves!
notes.notes:
Added:
[list]
[*]Steam Workshop support: create and share your levels on Steam Workshop!
[*]Cloud Saves: start your game/level on one computer/platform and finish on another!
[/list]

Fixed:
[list]
[*]sometimes platforms were remaining lit
[*]performance drops on lower-end computers
[*]fixed tutorial
[/list]
